title: File:Snow Summit, Big Bear.jpg
claims: The image is an aerial view of the Snow Summit ski area at Big Bear: snow-covered runs cut through conifer forest, with a small pond at the lower right and the valley beyond.

The Commons description names Snow Summit Ski Resort at Big Bear; the 100M descends from the Snow Summit summit to the finish, but this is not a race-day photograph and has no course markers, timing mats or aid tables.

The author is Doc Searls; the file is CC BY-SA 2.0; the photograph was taken on 2008-03-24 at 10:31:24; the original is 2,799 x 1,785 pixels and 3,817,582 bytes; the credit says it was originally posted to Flickr as 2008_03_24_bos-lax767d.
The route page uses a 960 x 612 copy of 218,578 bytes without cropping or colour change and credits the author, licence and source.
